Timing, poll counts, process ids and the Pi provider/model metadata of the recorded attempt (not part of the executor event contract).

Artifact delivery bound: 2 recorded read(s) returned more than 8192 chars. The replay starts the artifact MCP server with --max-output-chars 16777216 so these rows reproduce the recorded ledger (the recorded Pi worker received them whole). The stage-1 Pi adapter passes no limit, so the server default (8192) would cut them and mark the rows deliveryUnverified (docs/mcp.md "Delivery bound", R#9); a model would then re-read with a projection, which a replay cannot reproduce.

variants.description: The replay executor skips the Pi adapter's tool-mapping check, so the recorded workers are served although the original spec asks for the removed workflow_web_* tools. Shows how far the engine itself reproduces the recording past the C2 refusal.
unreproducible: Worker CLI stderr (pi-subagent stderr.log, e.g. Pi's session notice): the runtime stderr.log holds runtime diagnostics only; the replay emits no CLI output.
Worker tool calls other than workflow_artifact reads (read/grep/find/ls on project files, web tools): they only shaped the recorded final text, which is replayed verbatim.
Pi session files: the replay reports the ownedSession locator the Pi adapter would report but creates no session directory.
Timing, poll counts, process ids and the Pi provider/model metadata of the recorded attempt (not part of the executor event contract).

Artifact delivery bound: 2 recorded read(s) returned more than 8192 chars. The replay starts the artifact MCP server with --max-output-chars 16777216 so these rows reproduce the recorded ledger (the recorded Pi worker received them whole). The stage-1 Pi adapter passes no limit, so the server default (8192) would cut them and mark the rows deliveryUnverified (docs/mcp.md "Delivery bound", R#9); a model would then re-read with a projection, which a replay cannot reproduce.
Worker-filled web-source cache (worker-snapshots/<run>/web-source-cache): written by the removed workflow_web_* tools (C2); not restored.
